name: keith-tools
description: Keith Thornton's Claude Code plugins: structural code intelligence (jec-index), a live Node.js debugger (node-runtime), a working discipline for long tasks (deliberate), a tool-lights pane (a mod), and web-dev discipline with real screenshots (webdev-pro).

plugins.name: jec-index
plugins.description: Persistent symbol + dependency index for Claude Code: read one symbol instead of a file, see who depends on what, which tests cover it, and how an area is written - plus a hook that runs only the impacted tests after each edit.

plugins.name: node-runtime
plugins.description: A live Node.js debugger: launch or attach, breakpoints, stepping, scopes, evaluate and captured output over the V8 Inspector protocol.

plugins.name: deliberate
plugins.description: Decompose before acting, verify before finishing, reconsider on a cadence: the /deliberate skill, a verifier agent, and checkpoint + finish-gate hooks.

plugins.name: tool-lights
plugins.description: A pane with one light per plugin tool, MCP server or skill: amber while a call runs, green when it returns, red when it fails.

plugins.name: webdev-pro
plugins.description: Web-dev discipline: Playwright visual QA at phone + desktop that Claude actually looks at, a clarify-before-building habit, verify-before-done gating via a Stop hook, a fresh-eyes ui-critic agent, and /ship for the full pre-merge pass.
